title: Fifth Brother
description: As intimidating as he was lethal, the Fifth Brother of the Imperial Inquisitorius was tasked with hunting down Jedi and other Force sensitive individuals in the days of the Empire. With his immense power in the Force and his brute strength and physicality, he could scare leads from frightened citizens of the Empire and would use them to track down his prey and bring them to the Emperor's justice. He tried to take down Kanan Jarrus and Ezra Bridger, but did not succeed.
